rationale: Elias is a founder actively building consumer AI products and shipping LLM-based applications, while Atharva is an ML engineer student in San Francisco focused on LLM tooling and ML engineering—creating a natural mentorship and potential collaboration dynamic. Both share technical depth in Python and LLM tooling, and Elias's conviction about building for the current technological moment and staying current with infrastructure (vector databases, multimodal systems) directly maps to the kind of hands-on ML engineering work Atharva is developing.
intro_message: Elias Schwalme, meet Atharva — an ML engineering student at SF State working on LLM tooling who could benefit from your firsthand experience shipping consumer AI products and staying ahead of the infrastructure curve.
